class.name: FmodAudioEffect
class.brief_description: Abstract base class for audio effects in the FMOD audio system.
class.description: Base resource for FMOD audio effects such as Amplify, Filter, EQ, Reverb, and Delay. Add a configuration resource to a [FmodAudioBusLayout] with [method FmodAudioBusLayout.add_bus_effect]. A configuration can be shared by several slots; each slot receives a separate runtime instance and DSP chain. Parameter changes update the bound instances without rebuilding their DSPs. Use [method FmodServer.get_bus_effect_instance] to read live Capture, SpectrumAnalyzer, and Record data. The configuration resource stored in a layout does not hold the slot's audio buffers or analysis state. For standalone routing, apply an effect directly to a [FmodChannelGroup] with [method apply_to] and detach it with [method remove_from_bus]. A directly attached effect instance belongs to one bus at a time.

method.name: apply_to
method.description: Applies this effect to the specified audio bus. Subclasses should override this method to add their DSP units to the bus.

method.name: remove_from_bus
method.description: Removes this effect from the specified audio bus, detaching all DSP units.

method.name: get_bus
method.description: Gets the audio bus (channel group) that this effect is currently applied to.
